events.title: OpenAI o1 reasoning models released
events.summary: OpenAI released the o1-preview and o1-mini models on September 12, 2024 — trained for chain-of-thought reasoning on math, coding, and science tasks.
events.about: o1 models spend extra compute on internal reasoning before answering — improving performance on Olympiad math, competitive programming, and multi-step analysis. They marked a shift from pure scale to inference-time reasoning in frontier AI products.

narrative.whyChosen: o1 introduced dedicated reasoning models to OpenAI's consumer and API lineup.
narrative.whyImportant: Inference-time reasoning changed how teams approach hard STEM and coding problems.
narrative.problemSolved: Standard LLMs struggled with multi-step logic despite larger context windows.

events.title: Swift 6 released
events.summary: Apple shipped Swift 6 on September 17, 2024 with compile-time data-race safety available via an opt-in language mode.
events.about: Swift 6 turns data races into compile-time errors when projects enable the Swift 6 language mode — critical for iOS apps mixing async networking and UI updates. It completes Apple's push toward safer concurrent Swift after years of incremental concurrency features since Swift 5.5.

narrative.whyChosen: Swift 6 is Apple's biggest language safety upgrade since optionals.
narrative.whyImportant: Compile-time data-race detection raises the bar for concurrent mobile and server Swift.
narrative.problemSolved: Async/await adoption exposed subtle threading bugs that only crashed in production.

events.title: Elixir 1.17 released
events.summary: The Elixir team released Elixir 1.17 on September 19, 2024 with set-theoretic types in patterns, duration literals, and compiler speedups.
events.about: Elixir 1.17 advanced gradual typing with set operations on types in guards and patterns — catching more bugs at compile time. Duration literals (`2h`, `30m`) simplified scheduling code in OTP and Broadway pipelines.

narrative.whyChosen: Elixir 1.17 pushed type-aware pattern matching toward practical static analysis.
narrative.whyImportant: Set-theoretic types bridge dynamic Elixir and teams wanting more safety.
narrative.problemSolved: Complex guard logic was hard to validate without external type tools.

events.title: iPhone 16 released
events.summary: Apple began selling the iPhone 16 on September 20, 2024 — Camera Control button and Apple Intelligence integration.
events.about: The Camera Control button added a dedicated hardware input for camera and future app actions. Apple Intelligence brought on-device LLM features that iOS developers began integrating through new system APIs.

narrative.whyChosen: The iPhone 16 paired a new hardware button with Apple's on-device AI push.
narrative.whyImportant: Camera Control and Apple Intelligence APIs expanded how apps integrate with system AI and capture.
narrative.problemSolved: Mobile AI features were mostly cloud-dependent; camera access lacked dedicated hardware.
